3446-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Herald of Kozilek, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-574-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5223-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

728-803-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
728-803-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2034-2073-4659-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Elven Bow, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2021-2060-6260-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

5109-6899-7839.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Smaug and the creature with With Great Power . . . attached.
Smaug triggers, creating an amount of Treasure tokens equal to the damage it was dealt.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
955-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-6006-7297.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1733-2104-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Nephalia Smuggler.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

338-2811-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2811-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1459-4499-6913.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have Chameleon enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Chameleon enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Chameleon triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

628-5256-7216.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

1409-2557-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3899-4552-6705.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2173-4740-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
38-2173-4740-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

985-2854-4574-4708.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
985-2854-4574-4708.description:
Cast Dark Sphere either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

342-4131-6748.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, which is reduced due to Ragost making it a Food and Sam's reduction, untapping it.
Repeat.

2781-2921-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2397-3389-5954-6664.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1445-2366-4772-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-4772-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2196-2821-3861-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-3861-5803.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Orzhov Basilica and another land.
Activate Orzhov Basilica and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2793-3743-4094-5089-5437.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4094-5089-5437.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2793-3743-4094-5089-5437.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, giving creatures you control deathtouch until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature token you control.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1013-4067-5467.easyPrerequisites: Hypervolt Grasp attached to Wylie Duke.
1013-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
1013-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

2862-3120-4050-4182.notablePrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least five oil counters on it.
2862-3120-4050-4182.description:
Cast Whipsers of the Muse with buyback by paying {U}.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a 3/3 Wraith creature token.
Resolve Whipsers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return Whipsers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wraith, adding {U}.
Repeat.

905-2178-2485.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Bounty Hunter.
Bounty Hunter does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-2485.description:
Activate Bounty Hunter's first ability by tapping it, targeting any nonblack creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Bounty Hunter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a nonblack creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

876-1947-4763.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Reckless Barbarian.
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Koll triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1477-2558-3490-4390.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Sword of the Meek, adding {G}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.
